owen: Heads-up: seeing p99 spikes when compaction starts during short inference bursts. Quick idea: small "run token" + per-tenant defrag credits to make compaction preemptible.

maria: Sounds promising. How does a run token work?

owen: Alloc path requests a token with desired run-ms and tenant id. Evictor checks token heartbeat and persists progress at chunk boundaries. If token revoked, evictor yields fast.

lee: Important: chunk size + journal format must make interrupted compaction idempotent. Suggest 32KB chunk + per-slab progress record.

sana: Also add request-level hint prefetch_profile:short|long so we don't over-prefetch for short jobs.

maria: Telemetry: compaction_run_ms, preempt_count, tenant_credits_ms, small_req_p99_by_tenant, compaction_chunks_written.

owen: Ops knobs: --tenant-defrag-credits-ms-per-sec, --defrag-window-ms, --compaction-chunk-bytes. Rollout behind feature flag, canary 1% tenants.

infra-bot: created /infra/checks/defrag-token-RFC-1845612345 4cb 5 checks pending

lee: I'll prototype token API and add unit tests for mid-chunk abort/resume.

sana: I'll add perf microbench (short bursts vs steady) to the RFC.

maria: LGTM. Keep kill-switch planned.
